description: 200 Hz MIL-STD-1553 and ARINC 429 high-frequency flight sensor recordings capturing extreme aerodynamic exceedances, asymmetric dynamic loads, and bulkhead thermal gradients.

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: Primary Key (PK): Flight exceedance anomaly event identifier (e.g., EXC-20261102-ZM151).

fields.name: tail_number
fields.description: Foreign Key (FK -> airframe_component_telemetry.tail_number, Cluster Key): Aircraft tail experiencing the flight envelope exceedance (e.g., ZM151).

fields.name: event_window_start_utc
fields.description: Partition Key (DAY): Millisecond-accurate UTC timestamp anchoring the start of the 3.2-second peak dynamic strain excursion (e.g., 2026-11-02T14:22:18.420Z).

fields.name: structural_station_id
fields.description: Cluster Key: Airframe structural station and fuselage frame coordinate (e.g., 'Frame 496' Port-Side Wing Carry-Through Bulkhead).

fields.name: mach_number
fields.description: Unit: Mach (dimensionless ratio to speed of sound). Aircraft true airspeed in Mach at time of peak load (e.g., 1.3).

fields.name: peak_nz_g
fields.description: Unit: G-force (g). Peak normal acceleration load factor Nz in G-force (e.g., 9.4 G) during asymmetric maneuver.

fields.name: peak_egt_celsius
fields.description: Unit: degrees Celsius (°C). Exhaust Gas Temperature / boundary layer thermal gradient in Celsius (e.g., 220.0°C).

fields.name: miners_rule_damage_delta
fields.description: Unit: dimensionless cumulative damage fraction (D = sum(n_i / N_i)). Deterministic cumulative fatigue damage delta (e.g., 0.0042) computed by Palmgren-Miner's Rule.

fields.name: calculated_yield_pct
fields.description: Unit: percentage (%). Deterministic percentage of airframe Design Yield Strength (e.g., 104.2%). Values > 100.0% legally trigger mandatory Class-A NDI under JTD Rule 53-11-00.

fields.name: required_ndi_class
fields.description: Valid enum values: 'CLASS_A_ULTRASONIC_C_SCAN', 'CLASS_B_EDDY_CURRENT', or 'NONE'. Mandated non-destructive inspection classification.
